lines.en: Michael wants us to bond, so we need topics for conversation.
-Mike, get off of the lift, please.
We'll get somebody to clean that up.
We're the ones that got to clean that up.
-We have to have this thing in service.
Now, we definitely live in different worlds,
but we have a lot in common.
We even like the same girls, some of us.
-Hey, do you want me to go?
What bothers you as guys, you know?
-So, it really bothers me when somebody comes in here
speeding around on a lift, playing with it like a toy.
It kind of gets under my skin, okay?
-Okay, yeah, yeah, yeah, shh, shh, so --
-I hate shushing, you know, that's the thing.
-Okay, what -- okay, what is our beef as human men?
-You know, that's a good question, Hasselhoff.
That's what guys do, and we love it.

every weekend night, and then they're like,
"When are we gonna go on a date date?"

What do they expect, you know what I mean?
They take us out every weekend, you know what I mean?
-No, you don't. You don't feel us.
How can you? You know what?
-You say we're the same, but we get compensated very differently.
-We work the same hours as you, and you just said we work a lot harder.
-But we get paid a lot less.
-You know, this would not happen if we had a union.
-Man, see, that's what I've been saying, man.
We need to do this finally.
'Cause you already sort of have a union of guys.
-It's more than necessary, Mike. We need this.
Roy, do you still have that card from the dock workers' union?
-Man, hook it up. Come on, man.
-You know what? I think the problem is the chicks.
And you got to blame them.
